interpretation.attribution: STATUS changes include both the candidate effect and uncontrolled process/run variation. Do not attribute the entire observed ratio to lazy import.
interpretation.control: READ source/scripts are byte-identical between arms; its observed ratio is control variation, not an optimization gain.
interpretation.mock: Systemd and non-Linux mocks provide branch diagnostics only, not real service or OS performance.
interpretation.scope: Fresh interpreter component measurements exclude SSH, runtime throughput, concurrency and application end-to-end claims.

memory.scope: Cumulative RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss observation; neither per-child RSS nor traced allocation.
